summary: Lewis Hamilton faces a critical redemption moment at the Circuit of the Americas as Kimi Antonelli arrives just one victory away from clinching the world championship. Ferrari's pursuit of the constructors' crown intensifies amid McLaren's pressure, with pit-wall strategy decisions poised to determine whether Hamilton can salvage points or becomes a supporting player in his rival's coronation. A win for Antonelli would seal Ferrari's first drivers' title in eight years, while any stumble opens the door for Hamilton to resurrect his championship hopes and erase the stain of Singapore.
